title.ko: should · ought to · had better · be supposed to
title.en: should · ought to · had better · be supposed to

explain.ko: should와 ought to는 '~하는 게 좋다 / ~해야 한다'는 조언과 도리를 말합니다(should가 더 일반적). had better는 '~하는 게 좋겠다'로 하지 않으면 나쁜 결과가 생긴다는 경고의 느낌이 있으며 보통 You'd better로 줄여 씁니다. 부정은 should not / shouldn't, ought not to, had better not입니다. be supposed to는 규칙이나 예정(~하기로 되어 있다)을 말합니다. 조언을 부드럽게 할 때는 If I were you, I'd ...를 씁니다.
explain.en: Should and ought to give advice or say what is right (should is more common). Had better is stronger: it suggests a bad result if you don't act, and is usually shortened to You'd better. Negatives: shouldn't, ought not to, had better not. Be supposed to talks about rules or arrangements. To soften advice use If I were you, I'd ...

head: 구조 / Structure
형태 / Form
예문 / Example
rows: You ought to call your parents.
The meeting is supposed to start at nine.

notes.ko: had better는 형태는 과거지만 지금이나 앞으로의 일을 말하고, 뒤에는 to 없이 동사원형이 옵니다.
notes.en: Had better looks past but refers to now or the future, and takes the base verb without to.

notes.ko: ought to는 to가 필요하지만 should는 필요 없습니다.
notes.en: Ought to needs to; should does not.

notes.ko: must는 강한 의무이고 should는 조언이므로 세기가 다릅니다.
notes.en: Must is a strong obligation; should is just advice.

lines.t: What will happen if I'm late?

Yes, you'd better drink no more than two cups a day.

lines.t: Welcome, new staff. Work is supposed to start at nine. You'd better not be late. All staff must follow the safety rules, and lunch is one hour. If you have any questions, ask the HR team at any time.

trans.ko: 새 직원 여러분, 환영합니다. 근무는 9시에 시작하기로 되어 있어요. 지각하지 않는 게 좋아요. 모든 직원은 안전 규칙을 지켜야 하고 점심시간은 한 시간이에요. 질문이 있으면 언제든지 인사팀에 물어보세요.

items.passage:
HEALTH ADVICE
Question: I can't sleep these days. What should I do?
Answer: You'd better not use your phone before bed. You ought to go to bed and get up at the same time every day. If that doesn't work, see a doctor.

trans.ko:
건강 상담
질문: 요즘 잠을 못 자요. 어떻게 해야 할까요?
답변: 자기 전에 휴대폰을 보지 않는 게 좋아요. 매일 같은 시간에 자고 일어나야 해요. 그래도 안 되면 의사를 만나세요.

items.passage: Jimin was very worried before the exam. Her teacher advised her to go to bed early and have breakfast. Jimin decided to take the advice.

trans.ko: 지민은 시험을 앞두고 걱정이 많았어요. 선생님은 그녀에게 일찍 자고 아침을 꼭 먹으라고 조언했어요. 지민은 그 조언을 받아들이기로 했어요.

prompt.ko: 친구가 새 직장에서 겪는 문제에 대해 조언 4문장을 써 보세요.
prompt.en: Write 4 sentences of advice for a friend who is having problems at a new job.

task.model: You should talk to your boss first. You ought to ask your colleagues for help. You'd better not be late, or your boss will be disappointed. If I were you, I'd make a to-do list.

model_trans.ko: 너는 먼저 상사와 이야기해야 해. 동료들에게 도움을 요청하는 것도 좋겠어. 지각하지 않는 게 좋겠어. 그렇지 않으면 상사가 실망할 거야. 내가 너라면 업무를 정리하는 목록을 만들 거야.
model_trans.en: You should talk to your boss first. You ought to ask your colleagues for help. You'd better not be late, or your boss will be disappointed. If I were you, I'd make a to-do list.
